{{Pisces}}

Pisces is the 4th month of the [[Gaian calendar]]. It contains 28 days (4 weeks) and corresponds to ISO weeks 13–16.

== Overview ==
===Etymology===
English ''Pisces'' "fishes" (Latin plural). Japanese: {{ill|魚座|ja|Uo-za}} “fish-constellation.”  
===Gaiad themes===
Weeks 13–16 (Days [[Pisces 1]]–[[Pisces 28]]): crises and renewals; watershed ecological shifts culminating in festival alignments. 


After the colonization of the land, we have distortions

It is the month of easters and it has [[Cetus]] on [[Pisces 28]] which is the extinction of the dinosaurs
 
===EVENTS===
* [[Pisces 7]] — Easter Sunday  
* [[Pisces 14]] — [[:Category:Days_that_Qingming_Festival_falls_on|Qingming]] and Easter Sunday  
* [[Pisces 21]] — Easter Sunday  
* [[Pisces 28]] — Easter Sunday
